remarks: This is an rare opportunity to own a unique property right in the middle of town. This is one unit that lives like two separate units. A two bedroom one bath unit with Kitchen, dining room and living room. It has an attached one bedroom, one bath unit below that has a kitchen and Living room and separate entrance of its own. 4 Parking spaces and tons of Storage. Complex has lots of Green space for pet friendly activities. Walk to shopping, gym, parks and recreation, restaurants and entertainment as well as tr. Minutes to train and all major commuting roadways. Across the Street from ridgeway center and Scalzi park perfect for active buyers or people who need lots of space and rooms.
